keyFindings.description: envoy-go-race at c9b95f0c (job 121177536920) fails TestEnsureStreamWithConfigStartsWhenADeployedSubjectOverlapsItsOwn/narrow at line 453 with 'nats: error creating store for stream': the nats-server delete-then-create race testnats.RecreateKeyValue documents (nats.go:982-990). The parent test takes one account (URL and Connect at 421-422) and both subtests use its js; 'narrow' deletes the stream 'widen' made, the account's last, and recreates the same name at once. testnats.URL's own contract (nats.go:97-103) says each subtest gets its own account because subtests that delete and recreate one name in a shared account race. The test predates this PR, but it now runs against the in-process server, which the race detector instruments together with the test, and this is its first red at this branch's heads (envoy-go-race success at 7d38337be60f). 200 non-race runs pass in this pod, which cannot run -race (no C compiler). Fix: take URL and Connect inside each subtest, and check the module's other delete-then-recreate sites (DeleteStream/DeleteKeyValue followed by a create of the same name without RecreateKeyValue) for the same pattern.
